scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && vite build && npm run build:server

notes.three-stack: three / @react-three/fiber / @react-three/drei power the Phase 2 hero and Phase 4 technology universe. Lazy-loaded — only fetched when WebGL is available and reduced-motion is off.
notes.framer-motion: REMOVED in Phase 12. It was declared in Phase 1 but never imported — every animation is CSS-level (Tailwind keyframes) or useFrame inside the 3D scenes.
notes.server: server/index.ts serves dist/ and hosts /api/contact on one origin. `npm run build` bundles it (with api/ and src/shared/) into dist-server/index.js, so production runs plain Node with only express + compression installed. It imports the same handler as the serverless deployment, so contact logic exists once.
notes.dependencies: Only what the production server needs at runtime is in `dependencies`. React, three.js and the rest of the frontend are compiled into dist/ at build time, so they live in devDependencies — the build step installs them; the deployed app does not need them.
